summary: ALM Director, Consultant candidate with ~7 years developing and validating asset-liability and liability-driven investing models for institutional pension and multi-asset portfolios at Moody's Analytics and Ortec Finance, complemented by insurance-sector regulatory transformation experience (IFRS 17 / IFRS 9) at EY. Holds delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement; led design of an enterprise multi-scenario cash flow projection engine; and ran VaR/CVaR portfolio optimization, strategic asset allocation, and stochastic scenario analysis for institutional mandates. CFA charterholder with dual MSc and advanced Python.
core_skills: Monte Carlo Simulation & Stochastic Scenario Generation
Enterprise ALM Platform Onboarding & Client Advisory

sections.heading: ALM Model Development & Production Processes
bullets: Led design and implementation of an enterprise multi-asset cash flow projection engine supporting base, stress, and reverse-stress scenarios, delivering forward-looking liquidity visibility across ALM horizons.
Architected configurable time-bucketed liquidity gap analytics (T+1 through multi-year) enabling funding optimization, refinancing risk assessment, and asset allocation decisions.
Embedded behavioural cash flow assumptions, prepayment logic, and macro stress overlays aligned with regulatory liquidity expectations and executive contingency planning.

Re-engineered manual spreadsheet workflows into production-quality Python analytics pipelines with logging, validation, and auditability controls, using agentic AI development workflows (Claude Code, Cursor) that cut development cycle time an estimated 30-40% on comparable modules.

sections.heading: Investment Risk Measurement & Analytical Sign-Off
bullets: Held delegated sign-off authority on valuation, sensitivity, and ALM outputs for multi-asset institutional portfolios of $5-25bn per engagement (~$50bn+ cumulative), independently reviewing curve construction, spread calibration, and cross-asset interactions before production release.

Measured interest rate exposure and duration positioning under parallel and non-parallel rate shocks, and reviewed aggregation logic converting security-level exposures into portfolio-level risk metrics feeding downstream ALM and capital processes.
Validated derivatives pricing outputs across rates, FX, and inflation, confirming sensitivity and scenario consistency at portfolio-level ALM aggregates.
Served on the model governance committee covering methodology review, documentation and benchmarking standards, and model-performance assessment for client-delivered analytics.

sections.heading: Client Advisory & Communication of Complex ALM Concepts
bullets: Escalated outputs lacking mathematical or economic defensibility and acted as escalation point for client-critical analytical issues, interfacing with clients' Heads of Risk and investment stakeholders.

Prepared analytical summaries for senior stakeholders on interest rate exposure, scenario impacts, and balance-sheet sensitivities, translating quantitative output into investment-committee-ready narratives.

sections.heading: Platform Onboarding & Implementation Services
bullets: Led onboarding and implementation for U.S. and Canadian pension funds, asset managers, and consulting firms migrating onto PFaroe DB (risk & ALM analytics) and PFaroe PM (portfolio management).

Acted as technical liaison between client investment teams and product owners, advising on asset, liability, and ALM configurations, scoping requirements into development requests, and validating model outputs post-deployment.
Contributed to the successful migration of all assigned client accounts from a legacy Calypso environment to PFaroe PM, reconciling post-deployment output against client requirements.

roles.title: Senior Consultant - IFRS & Financial Risk Transformation

bullets: Delivered IFRS 17 and IFRS 9 transformation projects for Canadian and international insurance clients, aligning regulatory reporting requirements with system implementation and financial-reporting frameworks.

Advised actuarial, IT, finance, and program-management functions on IFRS 17 / IFRS 9 adoption; contributed to governance documentation and regulatory readiness, and developed advisory product offerings and go-to-market collateral.

Delivered ALM studies and liability-driven investment (LDI) analysis for Canadian and international pension funds and institutional investors, analyzing funding ratios, duration mismatch, and long-term balance-sheet risk exposures.

Performed asset-only and asset-liability (surplus) portfolio optimization on VaR and CVaR using Ortec's GLASS platform, with risk decomposition, contribution-to-risk budgeting, and near-optimal frontier analysis to test robustness of allocation recommendations.
Built and interpreted stochastic economic scenario generators assessing interest rate risk and funding volatility under base-case and stressed environments.

Advised clients on strategic asset allocation (SAA) and tactical asset allocation trade-offs through stress testing and sensitivity analysis, and designed stochastic risk-management frameworks for specific client mandates.

Modelled pension-fund actuarial liabilities alongside all major investment-product types and economic variables, and performed cash flow, liquidity, and hedging analysis across interest rate, inflation, and currency exposures.

Led onboarding and the ALM study for a three-plan university pension merger on a team of three, developing and validating the model capturing all Funding Policy dynamics and evaluating duration, currency, inflation, and leverage overlay strategies; presented findings to client investment committees on-site.

education: MSc, Chemical Engineering (Full Scholarship) - Western University, 2016
